nodes.label: Street Scene Smoke-Test Image
nodes.description: Small, low-resolution (roughly thumbnail-scale) unannotated JPEG of a suburban residential street: a curving road with painted markings, street lamps, hedges and houses, a tall grey tower block on the skyline, and a group of roughly eight adults and children standing on the pavement. Bundled purely as detector input, with no boxes drawn.
nodes.rationale: A deliberately small, mundane, multi-scale street photo is a cheap smoke test — it exercises person detection at several distances without needing a large asset in the repository.
